# Seabed: a 14-sided slab 14 m across (top at z 0), the top a gently uneven sand floor carrying
# one 64 px ripple texture over the whole disc (0.22 m a texel), rock sides. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Rock --base-color 0.000 0.373 0.549 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Seabed --vertices 14 --radius 7.0 --depth 0.6 --location 0 0 -0.3
apply --location
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
subdivide --cuts 5
select vert where "pos.z > -0.01 && sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y) > 1.6 && sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y) < 6.7"
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 6
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
material assign Sand
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Sand base-color ../../art/textures/sand_64.png
shade flat
export seabed.glb
